phrases.request: May I borrow your {item} from {start} to {end}?
phrases.cancel: Sorry, I'd like to cancel this request.
phrases.accept: Yes, please go ahead! I'll hand it over at the {spot} on {start}.
phrases.decline: Sorry, I can't lend it this time.
phrases.declineBusy: Sorry, I need to use it myself on those days.
phrases.handoverPhoto: I took a photo of the {item} before handing it over. Please check its condition.
phrases.received: I've received the {item}. I'll take good care of it.
phrases.returned: I'm returning the {item}. It really helped — thank you so much!
phrases.returnConfirmed: I've got the {item} back. Thank you! Feel free to ask anytime.
phrases.qr.late: Sorry, I'm running a little late.
phrases.sys.dueSoon: Reminder: please return the {item} by {end} at the {spot}.
phrases.sys.overdue: Reminder: the {item} was due back on {end}. Please return it to {name} as soon as you can.
phrases.sys.overdueLender: We've sent {name} a polite reminder about your {item}, so you don't have to.

tips.beforeRequest: Tip: in Japan, it's polite to return things clean and on time. A small thank-you snack is a nice touch, but never required.
tips.atHandover: Tip: a short bow and "arigatou gozaimasu" goes a long way.
tips.atReturn: Tip: if you'll be late, tap "Running a little late" before the due time — it's much better than silence.
tips.forLender: Your neighbor may not speak Japanese. Don't worry — Otonari shows everything in their language.
